builds.name: assay
builds.caption: a real run of assay on a live page
builds.tagline: A deterministic, browser-driven QA tool for web pages. No tests to write, no LLM.
builds.home_tagline: A deterministic, browser-driven QA tool for web pages. No tests to write, no LLM.
features: Discovers every control the page renders and works out a test plan from it
Exercises clicks, typing and navigation in a real Chromium, not a mock, and reports where the page contradicts itself
Fully deterministic, with a median run time of 14s
Ships with 15 wrappers that plug it into agentic coding harnesses as skills and plugins
